verdicts.title: Lower bound for the Complexity of the Boolean Satisfiability Problem
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: This paper depicts algorithms for solving the decision Boolean Satisfiability Problem. An extreme problem is formulated to analyze the complexity of algorithms and the complexity for solving it. A novel and easy reformulation as a lottery for an extreme case is presented to determine a stable complexity around $2^n$.
